assets.name: suspension
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the supplied original bridge icon. Preserve its strict flat side elevation, horizontal composition, recognizable bridge family, simplified large openings, few supports and oversized chunky columns, cables and braces. Replace the crude pixel-art rendering with a polished high-resolution hand-painted game UI icon: refined smooth contours, attractive dimensional beveled beams, rich controlled shading, soft highlights from upper left, subtle material variation, convincing wood/steel/concrete surfaces, and clean dark silhouette edges. Use many shades and pixels for lighting and surface modeling. IMPORTANT: large structural shapes with sophisticated rendering, NOT low-resolution pixel art, NOT an early Sierra game sprite. Do not add any small repeated details, rivets, thin rods, hairline cables, extra braces or tiny openings. Main columns and supports should be even sturdier, and cables visibly thick. Keep a fully transparent background and transparent spaces inside the bridge. No ground, scenery, water, text, frames, cast shadow or perspective rotation. Keep the bridge wide and around 2.2:1, with modest even transparent padding. It must remain clear when displayed at 46 by 24 logical pixels, but the delivered artwork should be high-resolution and richly shaded.
assets.shape_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tiny original pixel-art bridge UI icon. DESIGN ON A 46 BY 24 PIXEL GRID, then enlarge with nearest-neighbor blocks to fill the output canvas. This must look like a very low resolution 1990s toolbar sprite, NOT a detailed illustration. One pixel on the design grid must be a large square block in the delivered image. Bold charcoal silhouette outlines, just FOUR solid shades per material. Any column or brace must be AT LEAST TWO design pixels thick; main columns THREE design pixels thick. NO texture, rivets, bolts, speckles, fine rails, tiny cables, tiny window openings or smooth gradients. Strict flat SIDE ELEVATION, perfectly horizontal, width about 42 design pixels and height 20 design pixels, fully within the 46x24 grid with small even padding. Genuine transparent background, including all spaces between supports. No scenery, ground, water, vehicles, lettering, labels, border or shadow. Subject: a rust-red suspension bridge. ONLY TWO thick tall towers, a single thick sagging suspension cable, FOUR thick vertical hangers total, a thick horizontal dark-gray road deck and short chunky feet. Keep the cable at least TWO design pixels thick. No tower windows.
